title: Buttery Chirashi Rice Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring buttery sushi rice, onion, and chirashi.
instructions: Cook sushi rice according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over low heat.
Add soy sauce, mirin, and sesame seeds to the saucepan and stir until combined.
In a large saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add chirashi to the saucepan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine cooked sushi rice and soy sauce mixture.
Top with chirashi mixture, green onions, and additional butter if desired.
